name: Ambig-IaC
description: The scale and complexity of modern cloud infrastructure have made Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) essential for managing deployments. While large Language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to generate IaC configurations from natural language, user requests are often underspecified. Unlike traditional code generation, IaC configurations cannot be executed cheaply or iteratively repaired, forcing the LLMs into an almost one-shot regime.
